        "content": "Spring AI is a Spring ecosystem project that helps Java developers build AI-powered applications more easily. It gives you a Spring-style abstraction over different AI providers and models, so you can work with large language models, embeddings, image generation, and more without tying your code too tightly to one vendor.

### What it does
Spring AI helps you:
- Send prompts to chat models
- Generate and use embeddings
- Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) apps
- Work with vector stores for semantic search
- Integrate AI into Spring Boot applications with familiar configuration and dependency injection patterns

### Why people use it
- **Spring-native experience**: Uses the same conventions Spring developers already know
- **Provider abstraction**: Makes it easier to switch between model providers
- **Boot-friendly**: Works well with Spring Boot auto-configuration
- **Enterprise-friendly**: Fits into existing Java/Spring applications and architectures

### Common features
- **Chat clients** for conversational AI
- **Prompt templates** for structured prompt construction
- **Tool/function calling** support in some integrations
- **Embeddings** for semantic similarity and search
- **Vector database integrations** for RAG
- **Document ingestion and retrieval** pipelines

### Typical use cases
- AI chat assistants
- Internal knowledge-base Q&A
- Document search and summarization
- Customer support bots
- Code or text generation features inside business apps

### Example idea
In a Spring Boot app, you can inject an AI client and call a model with a prompt, similar to how you’d use any other Spring service.

If you want, I can also show:
1. a **simple Spring AI example**,  
2. how it compares to **LangChain**, or
